_metadata.description: OT-P0-002 — ranked next-best gaps with qualitative context.

requirements.title: focus ranks next-best gaps by impact x importance with qualitative context
requirements.description: The focus command/RPC draws gaps from all projections + convergence, ranks them by impact x importance, and returns each with its qualitative context so an agent/operator knows where to work without parsing raw numbers.

validation.notes: API: ranking is deterministic for a fixed gap set; target api/internal/focus.
CLI: focus output shape; target cli/domains/focus.
E2E: focus over live coverage + convergence gaps.
